title: Bill Todman Jr. touched a living UFO in a Teton meadow

tellings.quote: and he was climbing in the Tetons and he came up into this meadow and there was a UFO just sitting right hovering right there in the meadow

plain: A film producer named Bill Todman Jr. is said to have been climbing in the Tetons, a mountain range in Wyoming, when he came into a meadow and found a UFO "just sitting right hovering right there," which, as the story goes, he touched and found to be alive. The lawyer Danny Sheehan tells it second-hand, naming Todman along with Bob Rehme and Mason Neufeld as people tied to the story. If true, it would mean UFOs can be living things.
